name: Paladin
description: An oath-sworn melee fighter who spends Conviction, and takes on burdens for power.

specializations.name: Defender
specializations.description: A tank with a one-hander and shield who stays planted and earns Conviction by blocking and parrying.

specializations.name: Righteous
specializations.description: A two-handed holy fighter of slow, big moments who earns Conviction by landing Reckoning.

specializations.name: Blood
specializations.description: A fast dual-wielder of physical damage and bleeds who earns Conviction by reopening them.

15.name: Full Pardon
15.description: Absolve also removes a magic effect.

15.name: Unbroken
15.description: Stand Fast also breaks stuns and roots.

15.name: Retort
15.description: Blocks deal holy damage back to the attacker.

15.name: Measured Swing
15.description: Reckoning takes 0.5 s less to swing.

20.name: Easy Conscience
20.description: Oath buttons have half the cooldown.

20.name: Bastion
20.description: A big self-defense cooldown that roots you in place.

20.name: Upheld
20.description: A killing Last Word is ready again at once.

20.name: Bleed Dry
20.description: Ends your bleed on a target and deals everything it had left.

abilities.name: Sworn Strike
abilities.description: A free basic melee attack.

abilities.name: Sentence
abilities.description: The main Conviction spender, a strong melee hit.

abilities.name: Tend
abilities.description: Spends Conviction to heal you or an ally.

abilities.name: Arrest
abilities.description: A short melee stun on a long cooldown.

abilities.name: Stand Fast
abilities.description: A short self-defense cooldown.

abilities.name: Reproach
abilities.description: A free strike on a short cooldown.

abilities.name: Hush
abilities.description: A melee interrupt.

abilities.name: Intercede
abilities.description: Charge to an enemy or ally.

abilities.name: Absolve
abilities.description: Removes a poison or disease from you or an ally.

abilities.name: Vigil
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. You earn Conviction 50% faster over time, and your max Conviction is 4 lower.

abilities.name: Wall
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. You block 15% more often and move 15% slower.

abilities.name: Warden
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. Allies within 30 ft take 10% less damage, and you take that damage yourself.

abilities.name: Patience
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. Blocks and parries earn 1 more Conviction, and you deal 10% less damage.

abilities.name: Condemn
abilities.description: Swear this oath against one enemy. Your holy damage to it is 25% higher, and all your damage is 10% lower. Use it on another enemy to move it, or on the same one to end it. It ends if that enemy dies.

abilities.name: Stillness
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. Reckoning and Last Word crit 15% more often, and Reckoning takes 0.5 s longer.

abilities.name: Severity
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. Your spenders hit 20% harder and cost 1 more Conviction.

abilities.name: Penance
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. Your spenders hit 20% harder, and each one costs you 2% of your health.

abilities.name: Open Wound
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. Your bleeds tick 25% faster, and you bleed for 1% of your health every 3 s.

abilities.name: Solitude
abilities.description: Swear this oath, or use it again to end it. You heal for 8% of the damage you deal, and healing on you is 25% weaker.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: A shield strike that earns extra threat and heals you for 3% of your health.

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.description: Forces an enemy to attack you.

abilities.name: Hold Ground
abilities.description: Hits enemies around you and earns extra threat.

abilities.name: Stand Between
abilities.description: For 6 s, a nearby ally takes half damage and you take the other half.

abilities.name: Reckoning
abilities.description: A long-windup holy strike that earns 3 Conviction and heals you for 6% of your health.

abilities.name: Radiant Arc
abilities.description: A holy swing that hits enemies in front of you.

abilities.name: Last Word
abilities.description: A big finisher, only on enemies below 20% health.

abilities.name: Anoint
abilities.description: For 12 s, an ally deals 10% more damage and healing.

abilities.name: Lacerate
abilities.description: Opens a bleed. Reapplying it before it ends earns 2 Conviction.

abilities.name: Flay
abilities.description: A spender that hits much harder on bleeding targets, and heals you for 30% of that damage.

abilities.name: Red Harvest
abilities.description: Hits enemies around you and opens your bleed on all of them.

abilities.name: Transfuse
abilities.description: Costs you 10% of your health and heals an ally for 20% of theirs.

abilities.name: Bastion
abilities.description: For 8 s, you take half damage and can't move.

abilities.name: Bleed Dry
abilities.description: Ends your bleed on the target and deals everything it had left.
